title: Grid Paths with One Removal
statement:
Count paths moving only down or right from the top left to the bottom right that visit at most one blocked cell. The endpoints count as visited cells.

Input
n m, then n rows of m characters. . is open and # is blocked.

Output
Print the count modulo 1000000007.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,m ≤ 1000.
